TEXT
Artificial intelligence (AI) is transforming our world at an incredible speed. Machines can now translate languages, drive cars, diagnose diseases and even create art. Supporters of AI believe that it will make our lives easier and safer: robots can do dangerous jobs, and intelligent systems can help doctors save lives. However, many people are worried. They fear that AI will replace human workers, leaving millions unemployed. Others warn that if machines become too intelligent, they might become impossible to control. There are also serious questions about privacy, since AI systems collect huge amounts of personal data. The truth is that AI is neither good nor bad in itself; everything depends on how we use it. We must develop this technology responsibly, always keeping human values at the centre.

I. READING COMPREHENSION (8 marks)
1) Give two examples of what AI machines can do today.   (2 marks)
2) Why do supporters of AI think it is a good thing?   (2 marks)
3) Give two fears that people have about AI.   (2 marks)
4) What is the writer's balanced conclusion about AI?   (2 marks)

II. LANGUAGE (6 marks)
1) Complete with "must": We ______ develop this technology responsibly.   (1,5 marks)
2) Complete the conditional: If machines become too intelligent, they ______ (might / become) impossible to control.   (1,5 marks)
3) Put into the passive: "AI systems collect personal data."   (1,5 marks)
4) Give the opposite of "responsibly" = ______.   (1,5 marks)

III. WRITING (6 marks)
"Is artificial intelligence a threat or an opportunity for humanity?" Write a composition (about 12-14 lines) giving your balanced opinion, with arguments and examples. Use linkers.
